yt_title: How To Make A Cartesian Diver With A Ketchup Packet #Shorts
desc: How to make a Cartesian diver with a ketchup packet and a plastic bottle: squeeze the bottle and the packet sinks, let go and it rises. It shows pressure and density. New fizzy fact every day on Fruit Soda.
caption: Squeeze it and it sinks, let go and it floats 🧪 Easy DIY physics in 30 seconds. Comment DONE if you try it. Follow for a fact every day.

lines.text: How to make a Cartesian diver from a ketchup packet.
Step one. Fill a plastic bottle to the very top with water.
Step two. Drop in a ketchup packet that only just floats.
Step three. Screw the cap on tight and squeeze the bottle.
The packet sinks. Let go and it rises. Squeezing pushes water into the tiny air bubble inside, so the packet gets denser.
Pressure changes density. Squeeze again and watch it dive.
